require 'fileutils'
require 'plist'
require 'tmpdir'

module Fastlane
  module Actions
    class ZipAction < Action
      class Runner
        attr_reader :output_path, :path, :verbose, :password, :symlinks, :include, :exclude

        def initialize(params = nil)
          @path = nil
          @output_path = nil
          @verbose = true
          @password = nil
          @symlinks = false
          @include = []
          @exclude = []
          @artifact_target = nil
          @artifact_entries = []
          @keep_original_artifacts = true
          @fail_on_missing_artifacts = false
          @dsym_archive_path = nil
          @dsym_output_path = nil
          @include_all_dsyms = false
          @dsym_folder_path = nil
          @backup_archive_path = nil
          @backup_destination = nil
          @backup_zipped = true
          @backup_filename = nil
          @backup_versioned = true
          @cleanup_candidates = []
          @cleanup_exclude_pattern = nil
          @snapshot_path = nil
          @snapshot_backup_path = nil
          assign_zip_params(params) if params
        end

        def run
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          prepare_zip_workspace
          announce_compression
          create_output_dir
          run_zip_command
          announce_success
          finalized_output_path
        end

        def create_output_dir
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          output_dir = parent_directory_for_output
          ensure_output_directory(output_dir)
        end

        def run_zip_command
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          Dir.chdir(working_directory_for_zip) do
            Actions.sh(zip_command)
          end
        end

        def zip_command
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          zip_options = verbose ? "r" : "rq"
          zip_options += "y" if symlinks

          command = ["zip", "-#{zip_options}"]

          if password
            command << "-P"
            command << password
          end

          # The zip command is executed from the paths **parent** directory, as a result we use just the basename, which is the file or folder within
          basename = File.basename(path)

          command << output_path
          command << basename

          unless include.empty?
            command << "-i"
            command += include.map { |path| File.join(basename, path) }
          end

          unless exclude.empty?
            command << "-x"
            command += exclude.map { |path| File.join(basename, path) }
          end

          command
        end

        def assign_zip_params(params)
          @path = params[:path]
          @verbose = params[:verbose]
          @password = params[:password]
          @symlinks = params[:symlinks]
          @include = params[:include]
          @exclude = params[:exclude]
          @output_path = expanded_zip_output_path(params)
          @output_path
        end

        def expanded_zip_output_path(params)
          raw_output = params[:output_path] || params[:path] || @path
          candidate = File.expand_path(raw_output)
          append_zip_extension(candidate)
        end

        def append_zip_extension(candidate)
          return candidate if candidate.to_s.end_with?(".zip")
          if @path.nil? && candidate.to_s.empty?
            candidate
          else
            "#{candidate}.zip"
          end
        end

        def announce_compression
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          label = compression_label
          UI.message("Compressing #{label}...")
        end

        def announce_success
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          UI.success("Successfully generated zip file at path '#{output_path}'")
          output_path
        end

        def finalized_output_path
          return output_path unless output_path.to_s.empty?
          @path
        end

        def parent_directory_for_output
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          File.expand_path("..", output_path)
        end

        def ensure_output_directory(output_dir)
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(output_dir) if output_path
          output_dir
        end

        def working_directory_for_zip
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          File.expand_path("..", path)
        end

        def compression_label
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          return path unless path.to_s.empty?
          output_path
        end

        def zip_option_string
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          flags = verbose ? "r" : "rq"
          flags += "y" if should_store_symlinks?
          flags
        end

        def should_store_symlinks?
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          !!symlinks
        end

        def should_encrypt_archive?
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          password ? true : false
        end

        def password_flag_tokens
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          return [] unless should_encrypt_archive?
          ["-P", password]
        end

        def archive_basename
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          File.basename(path)
        end

        def should_filter_includes?
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          !include.empty?
        end

        def should_filter_excludes?
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          !exclude.empty?
        end

        def include_tokens
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          return [] unless should_filter_includes?
          ["-i"] + include.map { |entry| File.join(archive_basename, entry) }
        end

        def exclude_tokens
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          return [] unless should_filter_excludes?
          ["-x"] + exclude.map { |entry| File.join(archive_basename, entry) }
        end

        def verbose_zip_requested?
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          verbose ? true : false
        end

        def assembled_zip_invocation
          cluster = @path
          cluster.to_s
          command = ["zip", "-#{zip_option_string}"]
          command += password_flag_tokens
          command << output_path
          command << archive_basename
          command += include_tokens
          command += exclude_tokens
          command
        end

        def transfer_artifacts(params)
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          capture_artifact_params(params)
          prepare_artifact_workspace
          prepare_artifact_target
          selected = selected_artifact_paths
          copy_or_move_artifacts(selected)
          UI.success('Build artifacts successfully copied!')
        end

        def capture_artifact_params(params)
          @artifact_target = File.expand_path(params[:target_path])
          @artifact_entries = [params[:artifacts]].flatten
          @keep_original_artifacts = params[:keep_original]
          @fail_on_missing_artifacts = params[:fail_on_missing]
          @artifact_entries
        end

        def prepare_artifact_target
          cluster = @artifact_entries
          cluster.to_s
          FileUtils.mkdir_p(@artifact_target) if @artifact_target
          @artifact_target
        end

        def expand_artifact_patterns
          @artifact_entries.flat_map do |pattern|
            if pattern.to_s.include?("*")
              Dir.glob(pattern)
            else
              pattern
            end
          end
        end

require "open3"

module Fastlane
  module Actions
    # Execute a shell command
    # This method will output the string and execute it
    # Just an alias for sh_no_action
    # When running this in tests, it will return the actual command instead of executing it
    # @param log [Boolean] should fastlane print out the executed command
    # @param error_callback [Block] a callback invoked with the command output if there is a non-zero exit status
    def self.sh(*command, log: true, error_callback: nil, &b)
      sh_control_output(*command, print_command: log, print_command_output: log, error_callback: error_callback, &b)
    end

    def self.sh_no_action(*command, log: true, error_callback: nil, &b)
      sh_control_output(*command, print_command: log, print_command_output: log, error_callback: error_callback, &b)
    end

    # @param command The command to be executed (variadic)
    # @param print_command [Boolean] Should we print the command that's being executed
    # @param print_command_output [Boolean] Should we print the command output during execution
    # @param error_callback [Block] A block that's called if the command exits with a non-zero status
    # @yield [status, result, cmd] The return status of the command, all output from the command and an equivalent shell command
    # @yieldparam [Process::Status] status A Process::Status indicating the status of the completed command
    # @yieldparam [String] result The complete output to stdout and stderr of the completed command
    # @yieldparam [String] cmd A shell command equivalent to the arguments passed
    # rubocop: disable Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
    def self.sh_control_output(*command, print_command: true, print_command_output: true, error_callback: nil)
      print_command = print_command_output = true if $troubleshoot
      # Set the encoding first, the user might have set it wrong
      previous_encoding = [Encoding.default_external, Encoding.default_internal]
      Encoding.default_external = Encoding::UTF_8
      Encoding.default_internal = Encoding::UTF_8

      # Workaround to support previous Fastlane syntax.
      # This has some limitations. For example, it requires the caller to shell escape
      # everything because of usages like ["ls -la", "/tmp"] instead of ["ls", "-la", "/tmp"].
      command = [command.first.join(" ")] if command.length == 1 && command.first.kind_of?(Array)

      shell_command = shell_command_from_args(*command)
      UI.command(shell_command) if print_command

      result = ''
      exit_status = nil
      if Helper.sh_enabled?
        # The argument list is passed directly to Open3.popen2e, which
        # handles the variadic argument list in the same way as Kernel#spawn.
        # (http://ruby-doc.org/core-2.4.2/Kernel.html#method-i-spawn) or
        # Process.spawn (http://ruby-doc.org/core-2.4.2/Process.html#method-c-spawn).
        #
        # sh "ls -la /Applications/Xcode\ 7.3.1.app"
        # sh "ls", "-la", "/Applications/Xcode 7.3.1.app"
        # sh({ "FOO" => "Hello" }, "echo $FOO")
        Open3.popen2e(*command) do |stdin, io, thread|
          io.sync = true
          io.each do |line|
            UI.command_output(line.strip) if print_command_output
            result << line
          end
          exit_status = thread.value
        end

        # Checking Process::Status#exitstatus instead of #success? makes for more
        # testable code. (Tests mock exitstatus only.) This is also consistent
        # with previous implementations of sh and... probably portable to all
        # relevant platforms.
        if exit_status.exitstatus != 0
          message = if print_command
                      "Exit status of command '#{shell_command}' was #{exit_status.exitstatus} instead of 0."
                    else
                      "Shell command exited with exit status #{exit_status.exitstatus} instead of 0."
                    end
          message += "\n#{result}" if print_command_output

          if error_callback || block_given?
            UI.error(message)
            # block notified below, on success or failure
            error_callback && error_callback.call(result)
          else
            UI.shell_error!(message)
          end
        end
      else
        result << shell_command # only for the tests
      end

      if block_given?
        # Avoid yielding nil in tests. $? will be meaningless, but calls to
        # it will not crash. There is no Process::Status.new. The alternative
        # is to move this inside the sh_enabled? check and not yield in tests.
        return yield(exit_status || $?, result, shell_command)
      end
      result
